description.zh:
是否同时添加子集群到服务网格(ASM)中

- true 添加到服务网格
- false 不添加到服务网格
description.en:
Specifies whether to add the member clusters to a Service Mesh (ASM) instance.

- true: Adds the clusters to the Service Mesh instance.

- false: Does not add the clusters to the Service Mesh instance.

description.zh: JSON格式的字符串，可以被解析为一个字符串数组。要添加到舰队实例中的子集群数组。
description.en: A JSON-formatted string that can be parsed into an array of member cluster IDs to add to the fleet instance.

title.zh: 添加子集群到舰队Fleet实例

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adcp attach-cluster-to-hub --cluster-id cd08d62e6506a4fa5a8c44c19d0fc0000 --cluster-ids cdea10134be464ba4acb36cc831a60000 --attach-to-mesh true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adcp AttachClusterToHub --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId cd08d62e6506a4fa5a8c44c19d0fc0000 --AttachToMesh true --ClusterIds cdea10134be464ba4acb36cc831a60000
